abandon_criterion.note: stop a ladder early when a rung is refuted

bar.note: top leaders and high-distance entries, not a single cell

direction.expected_value: A corrected board frontier and a dated audit record, preventing campaigns from chasing soft bars.
direction.feasibility: leader_audit.py ladder supports escalating trials and writes witnesses on every new best; GPU runs the 300M rung.
direction.hypothesis: The board's top leaders by kd^2/n and all entries with d>=12 can be re-measured to 300M trials, exposing soft claims and correcting the frontier.

novelty.against: the committed codes/ entries and their recorded witnesses
novelty.claim: corrected distance readings for the board's most influential entries

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That the board's top claims are already tight at 300M trials, so future work should target construction rather than verification.

campaign.name: Deep board-truth sweep of top leaders and high-distance entries
campaign.notes: Top 200 by kd^2/n plus all entries with d>=12. Refuted entries are filed as distance revisions, not new submissions.
